feed.text: Chase is in on all five challenge holes. Confidence or delusion? We find out Saturday.
Ava is in on all five. She's been practicing her putting like Happy Gilmore at the mini golf course, so watch out.
Lucas is in on all five. Bold move for a guy getting strokes. Like Roy McAvoy said, he'd rather go down in flames than lay up.
Rex is in on the long drive and still weighing the closest to the pins. Classic Rex: grip it and rip it, then think about the short game later.
Nico is in on all five. Brotherly love ends at the first tee, Chase. Sibling rivalry is officially par for the course.

Arty V is in on all five. He lines up facing the parking lot and somehow slices it onto the flag. It's not a slice if it's on purpose, it's a GPS-guided curveball. Be the ball, Arty. Just a very confused ball.
Evan is in on all five. The smoothest swing in the group just entered the chat. Everyone else, adjust your expectations and your grips. Be the ball? Evan IS the ball.
Rex is all in. The baseball player is stepping up to the plate on every challenge hole. Reminder, Rex: in golf you want the ball to stay fair, and there's no bunting on the green.

Ava sticks it to 7 ft 6 in and Chase to 12 ft 3 in... then both forget how to putt. No par, no contest. Ava's short game strikes again, and Chase clearly skipped the YouTube putting video. Like Judge Smails says, the world needs ditch diggers too. Hole 2 still up for grabs: $35.

Group 2 checks in on Hole 2: nobody on. Rex swung like he was going for the left field bleachers, and Lucas is probably claiming he out-drove the pin. Two groups down, zero qualifiers. It's all on Evan now. $35 says the stick delivers or everyone gets a refund.
Matt is in on all five. The marathon man is going the distance, and he'll see every tree on the way there. Fore-ward progress, Matt.
Hole 2 is in the books and nobody won it. Three groups, zero pars on the green. A refund on 2, the putting gods remain undefeated. All 8 players get their $5 back after the round.

Arty V lines up facing the cart path, slices it 90 degrees and parks it 9 ft 6 in from the flag. Then actually makes par. Ball-istic accuracy. Cinderella story, out of nowhere. Arty leads Hole 6 for $40.

Long drive: Arty V is on the cone at 167 yds, the only one of the group who found the short grass. Nico swung out of his shoes and missed the fairway. Chase found the beach; somewhere a YouTube instructor is shaking his head. Arty is now 2 for 2 on leads. It's not a slice, it's a strategy.

Lucas takes over the long drive cone from Arty. Asterisk: Thomas bombed it past him but never texted in to play, so his drive is just for the highlight reel. Lucas will be telling everyone he out-drove you for the next 6 months. From the forward tees. Evan and Matt, it's on you.
Rex has pulled himself from Holes 13 and 16. The baseball player knows when to take a seat on the bench. Pots on 13 and 16 drop to $35.

Chase finally gets on the board: 20 ft 4 in on the 189-yarder, and he gets up and down for par. Not exactly a dart, but the YouTube putting video must've finally kicked in. Leads Hole 13 for $35. In the words of Happy Gilmore: just tap it in.
FINAL: Chase wins Hole 13 at 20 ft 4 in. Nobody in groups 2 or 3 could top it. Not the prettiest shot, but money is money. Chase takes $35. Somebody tell his YouTube algorithm.

Nico finds the green at 33 ft 3 in... then three-putts his way to bogey. Swung out of his shoes on the tee and kept the momentum going on the green. No par, no money. Hole 16 is still wide open at $35.

FINAL: Lucas wins the long drive and $40. Evan and Matt couldn't catch him. Brace yourselves: we will be hearing about this drive at every round, wedding and funeral for the rest of our lives. The forward tees have never been so proud.
FINAL: Arty V wins Hole 6 at 9 ft 6 in and takes $40. Lined up facing the parking lot, curved it home, made par. Nobody could match it. Arty's slice is officially a cash machine. Be the ball.

FINAL: Nobody wins Hole 16. Three groups, zero pars on the green. Refunds all around: everyone who was in gets their $5 back. Challenge holes are a wrap. Now it's main game time; post those 18 Birdies scorecards.

BIRTHDAY INVITATIONAL CHAMPIONS: Nico & Evan at 89 (+17). The smoothest swing in the group carried the guy who swings out of his shoes, and it worked. $100 each. Chase & Ava take 2nd at 95, Thomas & Rex 99, Pete & Arty 104, Matt & Lucas 110. Lucas, you can still tell everyone about the long drive.

payment_mode: One big pot: everyone pays Chase before tee-off, Chase pays out winners and refunds after the round.
